name: Chili Crunch Shrimp Noodle Bowl with Carrot, Cucumber & Bell Pepper

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place white and pale green parts in a small bowl. Place remaining (dark green) onion on a plate and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until onion is golden and crisp, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)

Add crushed red pepper, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer to the reserved bowl, along with soy sauce and vinegar, then stir to combine the chili crunch. Set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp crushed red pepper
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook until opaque, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and trim carrots; using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots into noodle-like strips. Add to the plate with the reserved green onions.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate.
To serve, divide noodles, shrimp, and veggies between bowls. Top with reserved green onions and drizzle with chili crunch. Enjoy!
